```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(introdataviz)

plot_split_violin_marker <- function(obj,
                                     feature,
                                     group_col = "snc",
                                     assay = "RNA",
                                     layer = "data",
                                     cols = c("SnC-" = "#296d9e", "SnC+" = "#cc0b01")) {
  
  # Fetch data
  df <- FetchData(obj, vars = c(feature, group_col), assay = assay, layer = layer)
  colnames(df) <- c("value", "group")
  df <- df %>% 
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>% 
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("SnC-", "SnC+")))
  
  # Constant X value so halves glue together
  df$feature_name <- feature
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = feature_name, y = value, fill = group)) +
    # 1. The Split Violin
    introdataviz::geom_split_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    # 2. THE CROSSBARS: Flat horizontal lines at the mean for each group
    # We use after_stat(y) to flatten the error bar into a single horizontal line
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "errorbar", 
                 aes(ymax = after_stat(y), ymin = after_stat(y)), 
                 width = 0.3, linewidth = 1.2, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), 
                 color = "black") +
    
    # 3. THE STATS: Wilcoxon test
    stat_compare_means(aes(group = group), method = "wilcox.test", 
                       label = "p.signif", size = 6, vjust = 0.5) +
    
    # Aesthetics
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14)
    ) +
    labs(y = "Expression")
  
  return(p)
}

# Run the list exactly as you had it
features <- c("BCL2", "HMGB1", "LaminB1")

p_list <- lapply(features, function(f) plot_split_violin_marker(
  obj = codex,
  feature = f,
  group_col = "snc",
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"   
))

# Combine and print!
final_plot = p_list[[1]] + p_list[[2]] + p_list[[3]]

final_plot
ggsave("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/results/260225/codex_split_violins_subsenmarkers.png", plot = final_plot, width = 10, height = 3, dpi = 300)
ggsave("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2//results/260225/codex_split_violins_subsenmarkers.pdf", plot = final_plot, width = 10, height = 3, dpi = 300)


```



```{r cell type annotation}
codex$snc <- codex$sencelltype
codex$sencelltype <- NULL

codex$age <- factor(codex$age,
                    levels = c("young", "old"),
                    labels = c("Young", "Old"))
  

SMA        <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["SMA", ] > 0
MelanA     <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["MelanA", ] > 0
Vimentin   <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Vimentin", ] > 0
Keratin5   <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Keratin 5", ] > 0
Keratin14  <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Keratin 14", ] > 0
Filaggrin  <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Filaggrin", ] > 0

codex$majorskincell <- dplyr::case_when(
  MelanA ~ "Melanocyte",
  SMA ~ "Smooth Muscle",
  Vimentin ~ "Fibroblast",
  (Keratin5 | Keratin14 | Filaggrin) ~ "Keratinocyte",
  TRUE ~ "none"
)

codex$minorskincell1 <- dplyr::case_when(
  MelanA ~ "Melanocyte",
  SMA ~ "Smooth Muscle",
  Vimentin ~ "Fibroblast",
  (Keratin5 | Keratin14) ~ "Basal Keratinocyte",
  Filaggrin ~ "Corneocyte",
  !Filaggrin & !Keratin5 & !Keratin14 & pc ~ "Suprabasal Keratinocyte",
  TRUE ~ "none"
)



```


```{r}
major_anatomical_order <- c(
  "none",
  "Smooth Muscle",    # deepest (vascular / arrector pili)
  "Fibroblast",       # dermis
  "Melanocyte",       # basal epidermis
  "Keratinocyte"
)

minor_anatomical_order <- c(
  "none",
  "Smooth Muscle",            # deepest
  "Fibroblast",               # dermis
  "Melanocyte",               # basal epidermis
  "Basal Keratinocyte",       # basal layer
  "Suprabasal Keratinocyte",
  "Corneocyte"               # stratum corneum (outermost)
  
)

#### calculate the frequency of SnC in each cell type by age

freq_major <- codex@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(age) & !is.na(majorskincell) & !is.na(snc)) %>%
  group_by(majorskincell, age) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = n(),
    SnC_Plus_Cells = sum(snc == "SnC+"),
    Freq_SnC_Plus = (SnC_Plus_Cells / Total_Cells) * 100,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Lock in your custom biological factor order
  mutate(majorskincell = factor(majorskincell, levels = major_anatomical_order))
  


freq_minor <- codex@meta.data %>%
  # Filter out NAs to keep the data clean
  filter(!is.na(age) & !is.na(minorskincell1) & !is.na(snc)) %>%
  group_by(minorskincell1, age) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = n(),
    SnC_Plus_Cells = sum(snc == "SnC+"),
    Freq_SnC_Plus = (SnC_Plus_Cells / Total_Cells) * 100,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Lock in your custom biological factor order
  mutate(minorskincell1 = factor(minorskincell1, levels = minor_anatomical_order)) %>%
  # Drop any minor cell types that aren't in your list (optional, but keeps plot clean)
  filter(!is.na(minorskincell1))


major = ggplot(freq_major, aes(x = Freq_SnC_Plus, y = majorskincell)) +
  
  # Draw the connecting line between Young and Old
  geom_line(aes(group = majorskincell), color = "gray70", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Add the dots on the ends
  geom_point(aes(color = age), size = 4.5) +
  
  # Colors (Assuming your age column has "Young" and "Old")
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Young" = "#296d9e", "Old" = "#cc0b01")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  labs(
    #title = "Senescence Shift by Major Skin Cell Type",
    x = "% SnC+ Cells",
    y = NULL, # Removes the redundant Y-axis label
    color = "Age"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray90"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black")
  )

ggsave("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2//results/260225/codex_snc_majorskin.png", plot = major, width = 6, height = 2, dpi = 300)



minor = ggplot(freq_minor, aes(x = Freq_SnC_Plus, y = minorskincell1)) +
  
  # The connecting line
  geom_line(aes(group = minorskincell1), color = "gray70", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # The Young vs Old dots
  geom_point(aes(color = age), size = 4.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Young" = "#296d9e", "Old" = "#cc0b01")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  labs(
    #title = "Senescence Shift by Minor Cell State",
    #subtitle = "Ordered anatomically from Dermis to Skin Surface",
    x = "% SnC+ Cells",
    y = NULL, 
    color = "Age"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray90"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black")
  )

ggsave("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2//results/260225/codex_snc_minorskin.png", plot = minor, width = 6, height = 2, dpi = 300)


```
